layer_improves_guidance.rule: best mid-layer arm beats the deployed-layer arm at matched lambda for >= 2 of 3 properties, each beyond seed noise with a corrected CI excluding 0 and not disqualified on quality or tokens

headline_falsification.rule: some arm beats its own compute-matched best-of-N

P_A_within_0.05_at_lambda1.prediction: every lambda=1 mid-layer arm within +-0.05 of its deployed arm

P_B_steering_best_layer_transfers.prediction: probe point 6 beats the AUROC-best probe point end to end at lambda=1, for both count properties

P_C_lambda_curve_shifts_left.prediction: >=2 combinations lose >0.005 validity at the section-19 optimal lambda, and >=1 count arm has a larger advantage at lambda=0.5 than at lambda=2

P_D_gap_stays_below_minus_0.05.prediction: best advantage over compute-matched best-of-N stays below -0.05, with hbd_count at lambda=2 the closest arm
